ring-nebula.d: Iconic bipolar planetary nebula in Lyra ionized by a central white dwarf.

local-bubble.d: Low-density (~0.001 cm⁻³) interstellar cavity spanning ~200 pc across the Orion Spur, excavated by multiple Pleiades/Sco-Cen supernova explosions over the past 14 million years.
